+# Data Protection Notes
+
+God's Eye View is a read-only dashboard of **public** data. It does not
+create user accounts, does not set persistent cookies, and does not collect
+personal data from visitors beyond what is described below.
+
+## Data handled
+
+| Category | Description | Source | Where stored | Retention |
+|---|---|---|---|---|
+| Public feed data (aircraft) | ICAO hex, callsign, position, altitude, speed — broadcast publicly by aircraft transponders | OpenSky Network, ADS-B Exchange, ADS-B.lol | In-browser memory only; never persisted to disk or database | Evicted when the browser tab is closed or the 4-second cache window expires |
+| Public feed data (vessels) | MMSI, vessel name, position, destination — broadcast publicly on AIS radio | AISStream.io | In-browser memory only | Evicted when the browser tab is closed |
+| Public feed data (satellites) | NORAD ID, name, orbital elements — published by CelesTrak | CelesTrak | In-browser memory only | Evicted when the browser tab is closed |
+| Public feed data (earthquakes / fires) | Location, magnitude, time — published by USGS and NASA FIRMS | USGS, NASA FIRMS | In-browser memory only | Evicted when the browser tab is closed |
+| Public feed data (weather) | Cyclone track, METAR observations — published by public meteorological services | NOAA / regional services | In-browser memory only | Evicted when the browser tab is closed |
+| CCTV stream frames | Still frames from publicly-listed street cameras | Municipal and transport camera APIs (TfL, LiveTraffic NSW, City of Calgary, etc.) | Proxied in-process memory only; no frames are written to disk | Not retained beyond the current proxy request |
+| Provider API keys | Keys for AISStream, FIRMS, OpenSky, Google server-side APIs | Operator-supplied via `.env` | Server-side environment only; never sent to the browser | Not retained; read at process start |
+| Client IP addresses | Used solely for in-memory per-IP rate limiting | HTTP request headers | In-process memory map on the proxy server | Entries evicted when the rate-limit window (1 minute) closes or when the map size cap is reached; never written to disk or logs |
+
+## What is NOT collected
+
+- No user accounts, passwords or authentication tokens.
+- No persistent cookies or local-storage writes containing personal data.
+- No analytics, telemetry or third-party tracking scripts.
+- No audio or video from end-user devices (microphone, webcam).
+- No location data from end-user devices.
+
+## Sensitive data notes
+
+All feed strings (ship names, callsigns, place names) are HTML-escaped
+before rendering to prevent injection. Individual positions shown are
+real-time public broadcasts, not historical profiles of natural persons.
+
+The rate-limit IP map is process-local and is not shared, logged or
+transmitted. It holds no data beyond a request count and a timestamp.
+
+## Data flows
+
+```
+Public data source ──HTTPS──► Server proxy (memory only) ──HTTPS──► Browser (memory only)
+```
+
+No personal data leaves the user's browser. No data is written to a
+database, file system or external service by this application.
+
+## Review date
+
+This record was created on 2026-10-23 and should be reviewed whenever
+new data sources or persistence mechanisms are introduced.

events.text: Summary of changes made:**
Package 1 — Static security analysis CI job**

Added a `static-analysis` job to `.github/workflows/ci.yml` that runs Semgrep with the `p/javascript`, `p/nodejs`, and `p/owasp-top-ten` rule packs and uploads SARIF results to GitHub's code-scanning dashboard.
Package 2 — Remove raw HTML sinks**
`src/intel/index.js:61` — Changed `n.innerHTML = html` to `n.textContent = html` in the local `el` helper (the html branch was never reached by any call in that file).
`src/shell/index.js:230` — Removed `layer.name` from the `el(...)` call that set innerHTML (the immediately-following line 237 already set the same span's `textContent`).

`src/shell/welcome.js:75` — Replaced the large template-literal `root.innerHTML` assignment with explicit DOM construction using `document.createElement`, `textContent`, `createTextNode`, and `createElementNS`; `innerHTML` is now used only for the two compile-time SVG/HTML constants (`COPY.title` and `t.art`).
Package 3 — Encrypted transport / HSTS**
`build/vite.js` — Added `'Strict-Transport-Security': 'max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload'` to `PAGE_HEADERS`.
`server/providers/cctv/constants.js:201` — Upgraded `http://webcam.warendorf.de/` to `https://`.
`server/providers/cctv/sources.js:1422` — Removed the literal `http://` string from the JSDoc comment (rephrased to "plain-HTTP URLs").
`server/providers/metar.js:121` — Changed dummy base URL `http://local` → `https://local`.
`server/providers/terrain.js:178` — Changed dummy base URL `http://internal` → `https://internal`.
Package 4 — Data protection record**

Created `DATA_PROTECTION.md` at the repository root, documenting every category of personal or sensitive data the software handles (public feed data, CCTV frames, provider API keys, client IP addresses for rate limiting), where each is stored (in-process memory only), how long it is kept (sub-minute or tab-close), what is not collected, and the data-flow diagram.

# Data Protection Notes

God's Eye View is a read-only dashboard of **public** data. It does not
create user accounts, does not set persistent cookies, and does not collect
personal data from visitors beyond what is described below.

## Data handled

| Category | Description | Source | Where stored | Retention |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Public feed data (aircraft) | ICAO hex, callsign, position, altitude, speed — broadcast publicly by aircraft transponders | OpenSky Network, ADS-B Exchange, ADS-B.lol | In-browser memory only; never persisted to disk or database | Evicted when the browser tab is closed or the 4-second cache window expires |
| Public feed data (vessels) | MMSI, vessel name, position, destination — broadcast publicly on AIS radio | AISStream.io | In-browser memory only | Evicted when the browser tab is closed |
| Public feed data (satellites) | NORAD ID, name, orbital elements — published by CelesTrak | CelesTrak | In-browser memory only | Evicted when the browser tab is closed |
| Public feed data (earthquakes / fires) | Location, magnitude, time — published by USGS and NASA FIRMS | USGS, NASA FIRMS | In-browser memory only | Evicted when the browser tab is closed |
| Public feed data (weather) | Cyclone track, METAR observations — published by public meteorological services | NOAA / regional services | In-browser memory only | Evicted when the browser tab is closed |
| CCTV stream frames | Still frames from publicly-listed street cameras | Municipal and transport camera APIs (TfL, LiveTraffic NSW, City of Calgary, etc.) | Proxied in-process memory only; no frames are written to disk | Not retained beyond the current proxy request |
| Provider API keys | Keys for AISStream, FIRMS, OpenSky, Google server-side APIs | Operator-supplied via `.env` | Server-side environment only; never sent to the browser | Not retained; read at process start |
| Client IP addresses | Used solely for in-memory per-IP rate limiting | HTTP request headers | In-process memory map on the proxy server | Entries evicted when the rate-limit window (1 minute) closes or when the map size cap is reached; never written to disk or logs |

## What is NOT collected

- No user accounts, passwords or authentication tokens.
- No persistent cookies or local-storage writes containing personal data.
- No analytics, telemetry or third-party tracking scripts.
- No audio or video from end-user devices (microphone, webcam).
- No location data from end-user devices.

## Sensitive data notes

All feed strings (ship names, callsigns, place names) are HTML-escaped
before rendering to prevent injection. Individual positions shown are
real-time public broadcasts, not historical profiles of natural persons.

The rate-limit IP map is process-local and is not shared, logged or
transmitted. It holds no data beyond a request count and a timestamp.

## Data flows

```
Public data source ──HTTPS──► Server proxy (memory only) ──HTTPS──► Browser (memory only)
```

No personal data leaves the user's browser. No data is written to a
database, file system or external service by this application.

## Review date

This record was created on 2026-10-23 and should be reviewed whenever
new data sources or persistence mechanisms are introduced.
